principles: The shell never executes arbitrary commands or manifest-provided shell strings.
Intent actions are limited to a reviewed local allowlist and require explicit approval.
Unconfigured capabilities default to denied in the shell preference profile.
File inspection and hashing run locally; uploads are not performed by the shell.
A UI control is not evidence that a kernel, driver, updater, model or runtime is connected.

desktop.scope: Mora browser shell, responsive layout, draggable windows, dock, seven original apps, six system tools, Newsroom and Horizon

intent_ui.scope: offline allowlisted actions, preview and explicit confirmation

local_ai_and_npu.scope: no local model runtime, NPU enumeration or kernel scheduling

approval_zones.scope: Mora intent actions only; system-level approvals require native broker

immutable_updates.scope: shell settings snapshot only; no atomic OS image updater

app_sandboxing.scope: Bubblewrap host-side wrapper; no kernel-enforced process sandbox in DuckOS

zero_trust_permissions.scope: deny-by-default shell preferences; no kernel enforcement

provenance.scope: local SHA-256; C2PA signature and manifest verification absent

adaptive_workspace.scope: Responsive browser layout, persisted light/dark palette and reduced motion; native XR session transfer remains absent

multimodal_input.scope: keyboard, pointer and touch; no voice or spatial input service

material_interface.scope: Mora Amber palette, SVG drapery wallpaper, dark radial workspace, glass surfaces, persisted light/dark selection and reduced-motion behavior

compatibility.scope: Wine-backed os-run user-space backend plus local PE inspection; no native PE loader or complete DirectX/Vulkan stack

declarative_configuration.scope: versioned local shell preferences; no full OS desired-state manager

accessibility.scope: reduced-motion controls and responsive layout; more contrast and assistive profiles remain

energy_awareness.scope: user-selectable shell preference only; no CPU/GPU power scheduler or VRR control

shared_design_system.scope: Shared Mora Amber semantic palette and theme tokens in the browser shell; native adapters remain separate

installable_workspace.scope: Web manifest and scoped offline asset cache including the Amber wallpaper; not an OS installer

native_platform.scope: Limine x86-64 kernel bring-up, initramfs builder and wlroots/EGL preview; no scheduler, VFS, process ABI or in-kernel drivers

core_user_services.scope: seven Python user-space services: PipeWire routing adapter, layouts, shortcuts, palette audit, safe command registry, session snapshots and profiles/event hub

newsroom.scope: RSS/Atom aggregation from fixed HTTPS publishers with a bounded loopback API and local cache

windows_runtime.scope: PE inspection, per-app Wine prefixes and argv-based os-run on POSIX hosts; no native Win32 kernel, bundled DXVK/VKD3D or anti-cheat support

package_store.scope: local staged package store with path and SHA-256 checks; signed publisher metadata and transactional OS updates remain planned

reaper_native_contracts.scope: Reaper source contracts cover memory, scheduling, IPC, trust, storage and driver orchestration; not a bootable kernel implementation

build_manifest_tools.scope: Python validators for system manifests, image layout plans and driver-module dependency graphs; not an OS installer
